pattern: East Coast Developers[^.]{0,60}\bbuilt out\b|One developer[^.]{0,40}built out Seaside
struck: One developer, East Coast Developers LLC, built out Seaside Plantation.
use: East Coast Developers LLC sold at least 94 of Seaside Plantation's roughly 160 lots, the first in August 2000 and most from 2001 to 2005.

pattern: Seaside Plantation's gate runs on written rules|gate runs on written rules
struck: Seaside Plantation's gate runs on written rules.
use: Four documents recorded with Horry County in 2019 carry titles about the gate and parking; the online index shows titles only.

pattern: owners association recorded three more policies
struck: Besides its Gate Access Rules, the owners association recorded three more policies with the county in 2019.
use: Besides the Gate Access Rules, three more documents were recorded in 2019: a parking policy and two entrance gate and security policies.

pattern: (?:No lot|none of (?:its|the) lots?)[^.]{0,60}touch(?:es)? a FEMA flood zone|FEMA flood zone, neither a high-risk
struck: No lot in Covington Lake East touches a FEMA flood zone, neither a high-risk zone nor the moderate zone.
use: Every lot is in Zone X, minimal flood hazard, on FEMA's current map; none is in a high-risk zone or the shaded moderate zone.

struck: Myrtle Trace's height above the rivers shows on the flood map.
use: Every Myrtle Trace lot is in Zone X, minimal flood hazard, on FEMA's current map.

pattern: library and a computer, each with a volunteer|clubhouse has a library
struck: The clubhouse has a library and a computer, each with a volunteer in charge.
use: The HOA site lists a contact for the clubhouse computer and a library coordinator.

pattern: back gates goes to owner volunteers|owner volunteers whose numbers
struck: A problem with the back gates goes to owner volunteers whose numbers are in the community telephone directory.
use: A problem with the back gates goes to two residents named in the HOA's gate guidelines; their numbers are in the community telephone directory. The front entrance is not gated.

pattern: some owners who offer paid help|neighbors have used in the past five years, including
struck: A shared list of companies their neighbors have used in the past five years, including some owners who offer paid help.
use: The HOA site keeps a word-of-mouth list of companies residents have used and referred, and a separate list of residents who offer paid services.

pattern: from 1 to 10 percent of each lot
struck: Three lots touch the edge of zone AE, from 1 to 10 percent of each lot.
use: Three lots touch the edge of zone AE, from less than 1 to about 10 percent of each lot; touching the zone does not put the house in it.
